scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks whether a larger/nonabelian model escapes the three-register obstruction. The direct predecessor PR #1333 already proves exact rank-sum cost when all rank-one affine displacements are paid. This cycle tests a strict four-label subset, a fixed mixed target tuple, and a different homogeneous-rank trajectory domain; it does not repeat the full-alphabet theorem.
bottleneck_link: PR #1333 proves a six-call optimum with the full rank-one affine alphabet; this fixed four-label subset has minimum in 8..10. That is a local alphabet-restriction result only. No physical, recursive, helper, frame, copying, hosting, precision, interface, or restoration saving is admitted, and the selected conditional kappa remains complex-bound.
stop_rule: Complete exact q=6 strict-drop coverage and q=7 six-drop/one-neutral coverage in the declared homogeneous affine representation. Stop after depth 6 has empty frontier for q=7. Do not search q=8..10 or infer a universal lower bound.
